control.C2_note: Rev 2 stated tolerance 0.05 C; replaced by the per-row rounding bound (C 0.1, A 0.1, cap_ah_est 0.01 resolution), max diff reported

axes.convention: C = A / cap_ah_est per drive; cap_ah_est = CAP_KWH*1000 / V_pack_median (per drive); CAP_KWH = 2.1 kWh is verified:false, C-rate scales with it.
axes.kwDefinition: drive-level peak charge power |peak_charge_kw| (derived as logged HV current x logged HV voltage); not guaranteed co-timed with the peak current
axes.medianLinesNote: median A and median kW are separate medians of per-drive peaks (not co-timed, not one operating point)

diagnostics.followUpTrigger: implied V = kW*1000/A outside [0.9,1.1] x V_pack_median on more than 10% of drives -> open a raw-pass co-timed kW milestone

refLinesAK.note: M358: A and kW values of the cRateRefLines lines (same columns and populations, no screen); the typical line is a median per axis (not co-timed)
